requirements: Use the route delivery context for units, data losses, inspection, runtime scope and recovery.
A declared operation is not a claim of native qualification; consult scoped source-bound receipts.

material.purpose: Create a bounded StandardMaterial3D with colour, roughness and metallic settings.

box.purpose: Create a metre-scaled BoxMesh with material and transform.

sphere.purpose: Create a metre-scaled SphereMesh with material and transform.

cylinder.purpose: Create a metre-scaled CylinderMesh with material and transform.

plane.purpose: Create a metre-scaled PlaneMesh with material and transform.

readGLTF.purpose: Import supported self-contained glTF geometry; inspect axis conversion and material limits.

sprite3D.purpose: Place a PNG sprite in 3D with explicit pixel size in metres.

camera.purpose: Create a perspective camera aimed at a target, optionally with the trusted orbit script.

directionalLight.purpose: Create a directional light with declared rotation, colour and energy.

capsule.purpose: Create a capsule with declared radius and total height.

torus.purpose: Create a torus with explicit inner and outer radii.

omniLight.purpose: Create a point light with bounded range and attenuation.

spotLight.purpose: Create a cone light with declared angle, range, attenuation and optional shadows.
